顶级弃少二最新章节_第1685章第1页_顶级弃少二北辰本尊_热点小说网
> 第1685章（第1页）
一旁的年轻女子和另外两人见此一幕，同样面色骤变，笑容消失。
短发男子一声厉喝：“他就算掌握着两门大道，也终究只是大道境后期，顶多只能弥补一个小境界，一起动手！”
他抬手一握，手中一把红色战刀浮现，刀刃上红光涌动，一刀怒斩而出。
“哈哈哈。”两人彼此大笑。却也是真性情，两人是真正的好朋友。
“齐国远。”徐茂功忽然喊道。听到不是叫自己，程咬金暗暗高兴。
唐大牛又是一声惨叫，再次被徐辰成功的将他即将迸发出来的真气逼退了回去，这股回流的极寒之气让他四肢瞬间麻木，身体重心不稳，仰面跌倒在地上。
龙昊赶到大厅时，铃屋此时和几位明显是高级搜查官的人聊天，看上去聊的还挺欢的。铃屋他那大大咧咧的性格让他几乎不会在任何场合下怯场，在冲着龙昊挥挥手，嘴里还吃着东西。
“又有人渡劫了，果然雷劫狂暴的气息少，大部分是精纯的元气。”外面的人又躁动起来。
无论是苍剑离休息还是修炼，云雷兽总是担任警戒任务，尤其是到了南域以后，这已经成了习惯，云雷兽能震慑百兽，只要它放出气息，方圆百里的荒兽、凶兽，就是妖兽，都得猫在自己的洞府，不敢出来。
“好我的校长，我哪里有时间，一不留神比武输了，不就成了野鸡吗。”罗士信心说，校长你总是不停的比武，大家不是在比武中，就是在准备比武。关键是输了后，全营人都抬不起头，不是野鸡就是野兔。
可把圆觉和尚给气坏了，你把我徒弟打的脑浆迸裂，还当作万多桃花开来欣赏，更气人的竟然还做了一首诗。他拿着禅杖身子抖的路都走不稳了。赫连章也气的不轻，看圆觉路都走不稳，他拿着刀冲过去要替他师侄报仇。
“九月底，肯定会赶在你生产之前的过去见你的。”刘斌保证着，家里有再多的事情也比不得陪他孩子出生来的重要。
神龙战队来了，青庐的巫师来了，阵图师和祭炼师分开，其他的巫师在一队。
他还是有担心的。最大的担心是杨成功太高大了，万一发生矛盾，他没有办法制伏他。要是个跟妹妹一般大的男孩子，他一定一口答应。
可是现如今，刘备得到了很高的军阶、爵位，但是在具体职位的安排上，却是凉州牧。
因为刘宏后面托孤的人选不是十常侍中的任何一个，而是后起之秀蹇硕。
事实也确实如宋十音所想，又有一名修士一跃而起，奔向了阵盘。
当时在蜃楼市安全局里与恶魔术士组织勾结的，除去句重自己，还有他的几个亲信。鸣义尽管躲过了他们的第一波追杀，到头来却还是栽在了句重的手里。

此时此刻，我正处于列车的座位上。暖洋洋的阳光透过车窗洒在肩膀上，窗外白日风景飞逝。
看到和昂热一起的两人，似乎还沉浸在自家校长一个镜头切换后就趴在地上的震撼中，路明非好意地提醒道。
王有财的梦境也就在这一刻，随着独狼生命的消散而重新恢复了自己的记忆。
这事要不是李萌今天提起，方一凡还真不知道，只能说高中生的暗恋，就是这么不顾一切。

The latest chapter of The Top Abandoned Young Master_Chapter 1685 Page 1_Beichen, the Top Abandoned Second Young Master_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 1685 (page 1)
When the young woman and two others on the side saw this scene, their expressions also changed suddenly and their smiles disappeared.
The short-haired man shouted: "Even if he masters two great avenues, he is still in the late stage of the great realm. At most, he can only make up for a small realm. Let's do it together!"
He raised his hand and grasped it, a red sword appeared in his hand, red light surged on the blade, and he slashed out in anger.
"Hahaha." The two laughed at each other. But they are also genuine, and the two are truly good friends.
"Qi Guoyuan." Xu Maogong suddenly shouted. Cheng Yaojin was secretly happy when he heard that it was not him.
Tang Daniu screamed again, and Xu Chen once again successfully forced back the infuriating energy that was about to burst out from him. This returning extremely cold air made his limbs instantly numb, his body's center of gravity became unstable, and he fell to the ground on his back.
When Long Hao rushed to the lobby, Suzuya was chatting with several people who were obviously senior investigators, and they seemed to be having a good time. Suzuya's carefree personality prevented him from getting stage fright in almost any situation. He was waving at Long Hao with something in his mouth.
"Someone has overcome the tribulation again. Sure enough, there is less violent aura from the thunder tribulation, and most of it is pure vitality." The people outside became restless again.
Whether Cang Jianli is resting or practicing, the Cloud Thunder Beast always serves as a guard. Especially after arriving in the Southern Region, this has become a habit. The Cloud Thunder Beast can frighten all beasts. As long as it releases its breath, all wild beasts, ferocious beasts, and even monsters within a hundred miles will stay in their caves and dare not come out.
"Okay, my principal, where do I have time? If I lose my duel accidentally, I will become a pheasant." Luo Shi said confidently, "Principal, you are always competing. Everyone is either in the competition or preparing for the competition." The key is that after losing, the whole camp couldn't hold their heads up. They were either pheasants or hares.
But you made Monk Yuanjue so angry that you beat my apprentice until his brains exploded, and you still regarded it as thousands of peach blossoms. What was even more irritating was that you even wrote a poem. He was shaking so hard that he could not walk steadily while holding the Zen staff. He Lianzhang was also very angry. Seeing that Yuan Jue could not walk steadily, he rushed over with a knife to avenge his nephew.
"At the end of September, I will definitely go over to see you before you give birth." Liu Bin promised that no matter how many things there are at home, they are more important than not being able to accompany the birth of his child.
The Shenlong team is here, the wizards from Qinglu are here, the formation master and the sacrifice master are separated, and the other wizards are in one team.
He was still worried. The biggest worry is that Yang Chenggong is too tall and there will be no way to subdue him in the event of a conflict. If it were a boy as old as his sister, he would definitely agree.
But now, Liu Bei has received a high military rank and title, but in terms of specific position arrangement, he is Liangzhou Mu.
Because Liu Hong's successor was not any of the ten permanent servants, but the rising star Jian Shuo.
The fact was exactly as Song Shiyin thought, another monk jumped up and ran towards the formation.
At that time, the people who colluded with the Demon Warlock Organization in the Mirage City Security Bureau were Ju Zhong himself and several of his cronies. Although Ming Yi escaped their first wave of pursuit, he still fell into Ju Zhong's hands in the end.
At this moment, I am sitting on the train. The warm sunshine shines on my shoulders through the car window, and the daytime scenery flies by outside the window.
Seeing that the two people with Ange seemed to be still immersed in the shock of their principal lying on the ground after a camera cut, Lu Mingfei reminded him kindly.
At this moment, Wang Youcai's dream restored his memory as the lone wolf's life dissipated.
If Li Meng hadn't brought it up today, Fang Yifan wouldn't have known about it. He could only say that he was a high school student's secret love, so desperate.
